transactions.source: Kaggle ealaxi/paysim1 (PaySim simulator output; itself synthetic)
transactions.sampling: all 8213 fraud rows + 800000 random legit rows
synthetic_fields: customer_id (seeded random mapping, independent of label)
txn_lat/txn_lon (85% home city, 15% random city, independent of label)

caveats: Fraud and churn come from unrelated sources; joining them by customer_id is a modelling convenience, not a real relationship. Cross-module correlations are NOT evidence of real behaviour.
Geo-distance carries no fraud signal by construction because locations are label-independent.
Fraud prevalence is inflated vs. PaySim (~1% vs 0.13%) by down-sampling legit rows.
Complain column in churn data leaks the label and is excluded from the churn model.

product_holdings.reason: source data has NumOfProducts count only, no product identities
product_holdings.constraints: row sum equals real NumOfProducts; propensities depend on age band, wealth, HasCrCard; co-purchase boosts: {"home_loan": {"insurance": 2.5}, "investment": {"fixed_deposit": 1.6, "insurance": 1.4}, "personal_loan": {"overdraft": 1.8}, "fixed_deposit": {"savings": 1.5}}
product_holdings.caveat: recommender metrics measure recovery of this generated structure, not real behaviour
